input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets or exceeds the preferred position. 19.1 gives a professional and workmanlike services warranty by qualified personnel plus material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications; 19.2 runs ninety days from the later of delivery or acceptance for Deliverables and for the full subscription term for hosted Services (better than the 12-month software benchmark); 19.3 adds no-malicious-code, compliance with Applicable Law, no functionality diminution and open-source protection. 19.4 supplies the required remedy ladder — prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, with termination and refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure in a reasonable period — and expressly preserves other remedies for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The 19.5 disclaimer is mutual and expressly does not limit any express warranty, so it does not swallow the warranty. No redline needed.
